sources.excerpt: Portable Distortion 424 MKII — BENSON AMPS Amplifiers Guitar Amplifiers Bass Amplifiers Tube Effects Speaker Cabinets Babylon Pedals Guitar Pedals Benson The Amp Finishes Extras Plugins Merch Benson Speakers INFORMATION Ordering Information Dealers Warranty Amplifier Care Contact Amplifiers Guitar Amplifiers Bass Amplifiers Tube Effects Speaker Cabinets Babylon Pedals Guitar Pedals Benson The Amp Finishes Extras Plugins Merch Benson Speakers INFORMATION Ordering Information Dealers Warranty Amplifier Care Contact Portable Distortion 424 MKII Our enhanced re-creation of a certain 424 MkII Input Channel ← Back to Guitar Pedals Portable Distortion 424 MKII Portable Distortion 424 MKII $199.00 Our enhanced re-creation of a certain 424 MkII Input Channel Add To Cart The 424 MKII Preamp takes it’s inspiration from the raw and grimy distortion texture and broad EQ control from a classic cassette 4-track recorder preamp. We’ve expanded the versatility of this circuit by adding a bypassable buffer that drastically changes the gain and character of the pedal. This helps the pedal play well with high-impedance guitar signal, making it capable of all kinds of sounds…clean boosting with subtle EQ, a treble boost, warm and dark textures, and all-out chaotic grind. Bypass the buffer hear the faithful recreation of the sound of plugging an electric guitar directly into the original.
